name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 15-35% on project cost for setting up new micro-enterprises; balance financed as bank loan.
plain_language_summary: Government help to start a small business or workshop — part of the cost is a subsidy you don't repay, the rest is a bank loan.

name: Stand-Up India
benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for at least one SC/ST or woman entrepreneur per bank branch, for greenfield enterprises.
plain_language_summary: Bank loans specifically reserved for SC/ST entrepreneurs and women starting a new manufacturing, trading, or services business.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana — Shishu
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹50,000 for micro and small businesses at the earliest stage.
plain_language_summary: A small, no-collateral loan (up to ₹50,000) to start or run a very small business — from any bank or NBFC.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana — Kishor
benefits: Loans between ₹50,000 and ₹5 lakh for businesses that are already running and need to expand.
plain_language_summary: A bigger loan (₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh) for a business that already exists and wants to grow.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹10,000 (first tranche), with higher renewal amounts on timely repayment, plus interest subsidy.
plain_language_summary: A small working-capital loan for street vendors and hawkers, with a cash-back-style interest subsidy for repaying on time.

name: Mahila Udyam Nidhi Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Soft loans up to ₹10 lakh for women entrepreneurs to set up new small-scale ventures or modernise existing ones.
plain_language_summary: Low-interest loans for women setting up or upgrading a small business.

name: Annapurna Scheme
benefits: Loans up to ₹50,000 for women to set up a food catering or small food business, with equipment as collateral.
plain_language_summary: A loan for women starting a food stall, tiffin service, or catering business — the equipment you buy secures the loan.

name: National SC/ST Hub — Dr. Ambedkar Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Handholding support, capital subsidy, and reimbursement for SC/ST entrepreneurs including special credit and marketing support.
plain_language_summary: Special support and subsidies for SC/ST business owners, including help getting bank credit and finding buyers.

name: TREAD Scheme for Women
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Grant covering up to 30% of the project cost for women entrepreneurs, routed through NGOs, plus training and counselling.
plain_language_summary: A grant and training program for women, delivered through local NGOs, to help set up trade-related businesses.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹20 lakh for proof of concept and up to ₹50 lakh for market entry, given via approved incubators.
plain_language_summary: Seed money for a new, DPIIT-recognised startup with an innovative product — applied for through an approved incubator, not directly.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Recognition certificate, skill training with stipend, toolkit incentive, and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh in two tranches.
plain_language_summary: For traditional artisans and craftspeople (potters, weavers, carpenters, etc.) — training, tools, and easy loans.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Collateral-free credit guarantee cover on loans up to ₹5 crore for micro and small enterprises, making banks more willing to lend.
plain_language_summary: Doesn't give you money directly — it guarantees your bank loan so you don't need to put up collateral.

name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Equity or equity-like funding for viable business ideas by SC entrepreneurs, managed by IFCI Ltd.
plain_language_summary: Investment-style funding (not a loan) for SC entrepreneurs with a solid business plan.

name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Tribes
benefits: Equity or equity-like funding for viable business ideas by ST entrepreneurs, managed by IFCI Ltd.
plain_language_summary: Investment-style funding (not a loan) for ST entrepreneurs with a solid business plan.

name: NBCFDC Term Loan Scheme (OBC)
ministry: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation
benefits: Concessional-rate term loans for income-generating activities for OBC individuals below the notified income ceiling.
plain_language_summary: Low-interest loans for OBC individuals with limited household income to start an income-earning activity.

name: Mahila e-Haat
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: Free online marketing platform for women entrepreneurs and self-help groups to showcase and sell products directly.
plain_language_summary: A free online marketplace where women can list and sell what they make, with no listing fee.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
benefits: Credit-linked subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost (up to ₹10 lakh) for upgrading unregistered micro food processing units.
plain_language_summary: Subsidy to formalise and upgrade a small food-processing or home-food business — pickles, snacks, dairy, etc.

name: NULM Self Employment Programme
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Subsidised bank loans with interest subsidy for urban poor individuals setting up individual or group micro-enterprises.
plain_language_summary: Cheaper loans for urban poor residents starting a small business, with the government covering part of the interest.
